# Brivellis Open GRC Index

> A free, open index of GRC resources (open-source tools, free kits, free courses, MCP servers, open datasets, official guidance) for ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST CSF 2.0 and Gulf frameworks (NCA ECC, SAMA CSF, KSA PDPL, UAE IA). Alphabetical, sourced, nothing paid or ranked. Entries marked House are Brivellis's own.

- Full data (JSON): https://brivellis.com/index/index.json
- Source and registration: https://github.com/brivellis/open-grc-index

## Entries
- [Acceptable Use Policy template](https://brivellis.com/index/acceptable-use-policy-template/) (House): Free template or kit. Editable acceptable use policy for staff use of IT and information, with an annex that maps sections to ISO/IEC 27001 control numbers.
- [AIMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 42001:2023](https://brivellis.com/index/aims-starter-kit-iso42001/) (House): Free template or kit. Starter document set for an AI management system, with an AI system inventory, risk and impact templates, and a completed example for a fictional company.
- [BCMS in Practice (free course)](https://brivellis.com/index/bcms-in-practice-course/) (House): Free course. 27 short lessons that build a business continuity management system with the BCMS Starter Kit and a fictional company.
- [BCMS Starter Kit for ISO 22301:2019](https://brivellis.com/index/bcms-starter-kit-iso22301/) (House): Free template or kit. Starter document set for a business continuity management system, including an impact analysis workbook and a worked example for a fictional company.
- [CISO Assistant Community Edition](https://brivellis.com/index/ciso-assistant-community/): Open-source tool. Self-hosted GRC platform with a large built-in library of frameworks, covering risk assessment, audits, applicability and evidence.
- [Comp AI Community Edition](https://brivellis.com/index/comp-ai-community/): Open-source tool. Self-hosted compliance platform for evidence collection, policy management and control implementation, covering ISO/IEC 27001 among other frameworks.
- [Compliance Trestle](https://brivellis.com/index/compliance-trestle/): Open-source tool. Command-line tool for managing compliance content as code in the OSCAL formats: catalogues, profiles, component definitions and assessments.
- [Cybersecurity Awareness Programme Kit](https://brivellis.com/index/cybersecurity-awareness-kit/) (House): Free template or kit. Templates to plan, run and evidence a security awareness programme, including a policy and a 12-month plan.
- [Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC 2-2024)](https://brivellis.com/index/nca-ecc/): Official free guidance. Saudi Arabia's national baseline of cybersecurity controls, with a free implementation guide, published by the regulator.
- [ISMS in Practice (free course)](https://brivellis.com/index/isms-in-practice-course/) (House): Free course. 26 short lessons that build an information security management system step by step with the ISMS Starter Kit and a fictional company.
- [ISMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 27001:2022](https://brivellis.com/index/isms-starter-kit-iso27001/) (House): Free template or kit. 13 files for an information security management system, built around one fictional company so you can see a completed example before writing your own.
- [NIST AI RMF to ISO/IEC 42001 crosswalk](https://brivellis.com/index/nist-ai-rmf-iso42001-crosswalk/): Open dataset or mapping. Third-party crosswalk hosted by NIST that maps AI Risk Management Framework subcategories to ISO/IEC 42001 clause and control numbers (prepared against the final draft).
- [NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0](https://brivellis.com/index/nist-csf-2/): Official free guidance. The CSF 2.0 core, profiles, quick-start guides and informative references, published free by NIST.
- [OSCAL (Open Security Controls Assessment Language)](https://brivellis.com/index/oscal/): Open dataset or mapping. Machine-readable formats (XML, JSON, YAML) for control catalogues, baselines, system security plans and assessment results.
- [Personal Data Protection Law (SDAIA knowledge centre)](https://brivellis.com/index/ksa-pdpl-sdaia/): Official free guidance. Official home of Saudi Arabia's personal data protection law, its implementing regulation, the data transfer regulation and guidelines.
- [Probo](https://brivellis.com/index/probo/): Open-source tool. Self-hostable GRC platform covering risks, controls, vendors, data privacy, access reviews and audits, with a Statement of Applicability and a CLI.
- [Readiness Checklists](https://brivellis.com/index/readiness-checklists/) (House): Free template or kit. Excel checklists to gauge readiness before an audit, one per framework.
- [SAMA Cyber Security Framework](https://brivellis.com/index/sama-csf/): Official free guidance. Cybersecurity framework for organisations regulated by the Saudi Central Bank, published in the SAMA rulebook.
- [Secure Controls Framework (SCF)](https://brivellis.com/index/secure-controls-framework/): Open dataset or mapping. Meta-framework of controls mapped to more than 200 laws, regulations and frameworks, downloadable as Excel and OSCAL JSON.
- [SMS in Practice (free course)](https://brivellis.com/index/sms-in-practice-course/) (House): Free course. 26 short lessons that implement a service management system step by step with the SMS Starter Kit.
- [SMS Starter Kit for ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018](https://brivellis.com/index/sms-starter-kit-iso20000/) (House): Free template or kit. 17 templates and worked examples for a service management system, from a scope statement to a workbook with a service catalogue.
- [UAE Information Assurance Regulation](https://brivellis.com/index/uae-ia-regulation/): Official free guidance. Information assurance requirements for entities in the UAE, mandatory for those designated as critical; published on the UAE Government portal.
